items.title: Joe Williams interviewed by Leslie Gourse, New York City, New York, March 9, 1996
items.q: Yeah. Shirley Horn, did a thing with her.

ctx.x: Oh I knew Carmen and Sarah.
Ella first, yeah. “Party Blues” with Ella, and “Too Close for Comfort.” Stuff we did for the 1957 Metronome All-Stars. And Shirley Horn.

items.title: Horn Shirley — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I asked John Levy. He said, ―Yeah, it‘s a good label. Joe Williams is on the label.‖ I said, ―Oh, I hadn‘t even noticed.‖

ctx.x: I know the name very well, but I don‘t know exactly why. I know he‘s an agent.
That‘s right. At that time, John Levy had, oh, good lord, he had all the top acts. He had Wes Montgomery. Well, he‘s had Nancy Wilson and Joe Williams for fifty years.
